title: Sum of Subarray Ranges
goal: Sum the difference between maximum and minimum over every contiguous subarray.
strategy: Count each value contribution as a maximum and as a minimum using monotonic stacks. Opposite strictness on the two sides assigns tied extrema to exactly one occurrence.

phasePurposes.start: Sum the difference between maximum and minimum over every contiguous subarray.

edgeCases: Equal values have zero range in every subarray
A singleton has no maximum-minus-minimum gap
Strictly descending values flush one stack direction repeatedly
